content.text: Should we switch the nightly backup from 2am to 4am? The 2am slot keeps colliding with the sync job.
Moving it to 4am would clear the collision, but the backup would then overlap the morning report job. Both slots have a cost.
Right. I am not deciding today. I want to see when the report job actually runs first.
Sounds good. The backup stays at 2am for now and the move stays an open question.
